column1: # What a comparison returns. Registering this kind is what turns
# `1000兆 = 1 GB` from an unresolvable expression into `true`.
# `true` and `false` are not translated, and that is this file's finding
# rather than an oversight it hides: the kind ships no vocabulary at all,
# so `formatValue` degrades to the unit key in every language. A Chinese
# engine answering "true" is what the code does today, and a row asserting
# it is what makes a later `boolean/locale/zh` a visible diff here.
# No space between a number and its unit, on either side of a comparison.
# Chinese writes none and the reader wants none.
# A word operator does need the surrounding whitespace, even in a language
# that writes no spaces at all; the `*` and `/` symbols do not.
# Conversion keywords need no space. Three of the four are verbs.
# The myriad: Chinese counts in ten-thousands, so 一万 is one word for what
# No number agreement anywhere. One unit word serves every count.
